styles.name: vesica-piscis
styles.description: Two circles overlap to reveal the sacred lens; arc segments appear with eased progress

styles.name: seed-of-life
styles.description: Seed of Life: a row of seeds, each seven equal circles — one centre and six around it, every one passing through the centre — set circle by circle and seed by seed as progress rises, slowly turning

styles.name: flower-of-life
styles.description: Flower of Life lattice: equal circles on a hexagonal grid, each through its neighbours' centres, blooming left to right as a drifting frieze

styles.name: egg-of-life
styles.description: Egg of Life: a row of seed clusters, each seven touching spheres — one centre, six around, highlighted and swaying in 3-D — set sphere by sphere and cluster by cluster as progress rises

styles.name: fruit-of-life
styles.description: Fruit of Life: a row of thirteen-circle fruits — a centre, six around and six beyond along the hexagonal axes, never touching — each set ring by ring as progress rises

styles.name: metatrons-cube
styles.description: Metatron's Cube: a row of cubes, each the 13 Fruit-of-Life node circles joined into outer hexagon and great hexagram, drawn family by family and cube by cube as progress rises, slowly turning

styles.name: germ-of-life
styles.description: Germ of Life: a row of seven-circle germs — the six-petal flower cut cut by six circles centred on a ring, a seed at its heart and the circle centres marked — petal by petal as progress rises

styles.name: tripod-of-life
styles.description: Tripod of Life: a row of three mutually overlapping circles turning about their shared centre, a three-arm spoke joining their centres — circle by circle and tripod by tripod as progress rises

styles.name: tree-of-life
styles.description: Kabbalistic Tree of Life laid on its side: 10 sephirot on three pillars, the 22 paths drawn crown to kingdom with progress while the lightning flash runs the sephirot in order

styles.name: 64-tetra-grid
styles.description: 64-tetrahedron grid: the lattice seen down its axis as a row of edge-sharing hexagons, each filled with a star tetrahedron (two interlocking triangles), its axes and core — tile by tile with progress

styles.name: torus-flower
styles.description: Torus flower: a row of tori, each eight tube circles rotated about an open centre into a ring, turning with time — circle by circle and torus by torus as progress rises
